Name: Cottoncloud Town
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
Currently adds: a new town in the clouds, 9 NPCs, 47 foods/recipes, 8 fish and 46 furniture items with much more to come!

[size=5][u][b]How to Access the Town:[/b]
[/u][/size]Must have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url] mod. Go to Central Station and access the ticket machine, then select Cottoncloud Town as your destination. While in Cottoncloud Town, you can once again use the ticket machine to return to Central Station.

[u][size=5][b]Future Update Features:[/b][/size][/u]
[spoiler]♡ [b]Visits from other Sanrio characters:[/b]
Certain Sanrio characters will visit on certain days and will reside at the inn. Even though they won't be full-time NPCs, they'll still be friendable. They will each have their own recipe/food to bring to the cafe.
Current planned characters include Hello Kitty, My Melody, Kuromi, Pochacco, Pompompurin, Tuxedosam, Keroppi, Badtz-Maru, Usahana, Bonbonribbon, Wish Me Mell, Chococat and potentially any others that get suggested!

♡ [b]Heart events for all NPCs and other fun extra events[/b]

♡[b] The rest of Cinnamoroll's friends move back in:[/b]
Poron & Corune and Lloromannic will eventually move back into their respective homes and will be regular NPCs.

♡ [b]More buildings/shops[/b]

♡ [b]More food and furniture[/b][/spoiler]
